title: Hole in cave and house
content: So one reoccurring aspect of my mall word dreams is that there’s this hole/ crevice thing in the ground. About 3 feet circular. I would say maybe purplish. Kind of hard to remember. Thing is this shows up in a house often for me and whenever I see it I know something bad is going to happen. I’ve gone inside the hole before and these are the dreams where I straight up like die so always very scary. There’s also a hole in this large cave. The cave seems normal at first and holds underground living people/ things off a few branches off the cave but the mane cave is empty wet gross. Then you keep walking and find the hole and then scary stuff happens again. This hole shows up randomly and always has negative connotations. Anyone have anything similar ?
